database.name: ECB reuse conditions
database.text: Summary of ECB source conditions: reproduce accurately and credit the ECB; disclose modifications. For information incorporated in sold documents, inform buyers before payment and on each access that the original is available free from the ECB. Open ECB business/promotional links in the full browser window. Author-named papers have a separate permission exception. The canonical linked terms govern. Rates are published for information purposes; transaction use is strongly discouraged.
